summary: Iteration 2 testing: Chess/Uno/Ludo + Daily Challenge + Share Card + PWA. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests passed (games/meta returns 9 games; POST /games/submit accepts chess/uno/ludo with correct XP; xp_gained/challenge_completed booleans present; unknown game_id rejected 400; /challenge/today shape+auth+deterministic; challenge completion awards +100 XP bonus once and sets claimed=true). Frontend: /play/chess loads chess-board with all 32 pieces, e2->e4 move works; /play/uno loads with top card visible, hand of 7 cards, uno-draw button; /play/ludo loads with track, You/CPU panels, ludo-roll works and CPU takes turn when not-6 with all tokens home; ShareCard modal auto-opens after game (verified via RPS series) with share-native-btn/share-copy-btn/share-close-btn all present; Home shows 9 game cards + DailyChallenge banner + '9 CLASSIC GAMES' stat; manifest.json + logo.svg + service-worker.js all served 200.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing <link rel="manifest" href="/manifest.json"> tag. Comment says 'manifest.json is linked above' but no actual link element exists. Chrome will not fire beforeinstallprompt without it, breaking PWA install.
Malformed file: duplicate posthog init script and stray content after </html> on lines 111-131 (second </body></html>). File should end at line 110.
Console warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for accessibility'. Add a <DialogTitle> (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) inside DialogContent.

action_items: Add <link rel="manifest" href="%PUBLIC_URL%/manifest.json" /> inside <head> of /app/frontend/public/index.html (currently missing).
Remove duplicate content after </html> on lines 111-131 of index.html.
Add DialogTitle (VisuallyHidden if not visually needed) inside ShareCard DialogContent to satisfy Radix a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: XP_DAILY_BONUS logic looks correct — checked-after-progress guard via 'daily.get(claimed)' prevents double-award.
server.py: get_todays_challenge uses date.toordinal() % len(DAILY_CHALLENGES) — deterministic per UTC day, verified.
public_user does not expose 'daily' field. Frontend DailyChallenge component must fetch /api/challenge/today separately (verified working).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all core flows work; index.html manifest link + malformed tail need main-agent fix)
